title: 3 Coolest Mobile Suits from Gundam Wing After 30 Years
content: The first and arguably most popular Gundam show for American audiences dropped a quarter century ago, and it featured some all-time mobile suits. Mobile Suit Gundam Wing was released through Toonami in 2000 and jettisoned Gundam right to the top of all mecha anime lists.
author: ComicBook

title: Daily Report About My Witch Senpai Manga Ends
content: Seven Seas Entertainment releases the manga, and it describes the story: Misono is an office drone with his own ups and downs at work, but thankfully, he has an ally: his senpai Shizuka, who happens to be a witch.

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland Season 2: Episode of Savanaclaw Reveals New Visual, December 23 Premiere
content: Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation: Episode of Savanaclaw revealed a new visual, along with a December 23 premiere date. The anime will be streaming weekly exclusively on Disney+ (Disney Plus), with eight confirmed episodes. Fairouz Ai has also joined the cast as Yuga Hirasaka.
author: Anime Corner

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Rises Back to #2, Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi Anime Film Opens at #6
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, rose from #7 to #2 in its 14th weekend in Japan's box office.
author: ANN

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland Anime's 'Episode of Savanaclaw' Begins 8-Episode Run on December 23
content: Disney+ announced on Thursday that it will begin streaming Episode of Savanaclaw , the second season for the Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation series , on December 23. The season will have eight episodes.

title: Shingo Natsume Will Appear at Edinburgh Scotland Loves Anime on November 16
content: The film will also be shown at Edinburgh's Cameo Picturehouse (without a Q&A) on Friday November 20 at 9 p.m. It will additionally be shown during the London leg of the festival, also with a live Q&A with Natsume, on Friday November 13 at 7.50 p.m at the Picturehouse Central cinema.

title: Bleach’s Creator Had Its Ending in Mind From the Very Beginning
content: Bleach has finally come to an end with the right arc, giving the series the perfect ending fans had envisioned. What makes this ending even more special is that Tite Kubo had always envisioned his series concluding this way.
